retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast theatrical composition featuring a pale, makeup-heavy face in profile emerging from total darkness beneath a suspended, expressive hand.
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required
modern minimalist sans-serif typography is preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, low-key photograph where a subject with white greasepaint makeup looks upward in profile. A disembodied hand hovers above them, fingers splayed, creating a sense of puppetry or benediction. The entire scene is set against a deep matte black void, with text integrated into the upper left quadrant through flowing, interconnected script.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical tension between the upward-looking face and the downward-reaching hand
Extreme tonal contrast between pale skin/makeup and the absolute black background
Integration of diagonal script with the angle of the reaching hand
Warm highlights on the cheek contrasting with cool white face paint
coreInvariants: Absolute black background with no visible horizon or environment
Subject in sharp profile looking toward the left
Hand positioned in the upper right/center reaching toward the left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Face occupies the lower left quadrant; hand occupies the upper center-right; typography occupies the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, white-painted face in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the gaze upward to the hand, then moves left to the script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; over 60% of the frame is pure black negative space.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Stark white greasepaint and pale skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange/peach blush on the cheek and subtle pink in the script
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with very low overall saturation, except for localized warmth on the face.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to black, white, flesh tones, and a single warm accent color

letterConstructionRules: Continuous, fluid strokes mimicking a fountain pen
Variable line weight with thin upstrokes and thicker downstrokes
Long, dramatic descenders and ascenders that integrate into the composition
Diagonal orientation following the angle of the hand
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature sharp, aggressive angles
Lowercase letters are rounded and loopy
Extended horizontal bars that underline other words

anatomy.corners: sharp on capitals, rounded on lowercase

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script style to maintain theatrical focus.

preserve: High contrast between capitals and lowercase

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the dramatic, slightly gothic rock tone
Captures the era-specific hand-drawn branding style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast noir photograph on a pure black background. In the lower left, show a person in profile with white mime makeup and a warm orange blush on the cheek, looking upward. In the upper right, show a pale hand reaching down and across toward the left, fingers splayed.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered cursive script in the upper left quadrant. The script should be tilted diagonally to match the hand's angle, featuring thin, elegant strokes in a pale pinkish-white hue.

verificationChecks: Is the background absolute black without noise?
Does the makeup look like thick theatrical greasepaint?
Is the typography fluid and interconnected?
Is the vertical tension between the face and hand maintained?

mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the profile and hand

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black levels in the background
Ensure the script does not overlap the face or hand
Verify the profile is strictly side-view
Confirm the hand looks expressive and not distorted
recipe.reuseFormula: Theatrical Profile + Suspended Hand + Noir Lighting + Integrated Script
